messages:
Alex R: Heads-up — noticed ~3.2% lower usage reported from our sandbox marketplace webhook vs prod for the same test runs over the last 24h. This looks like a billing delta that could affect partner invoices. Anyone else seeing drift?
Priya N: I saw a small spike in retries yesterday, could be dedupe TTL kicking in differently between envs. Do we still use the same shard-key logic in sandbox?
Samir K: @Priya N we do, but sandbox has an older queue consumer (v1.9) — prod moved to 2.1 with idempotency header support. That could change how duplicate events get dropped.
Alex R: Good point. Looking at an example pair: the sandbox event has no `X-ML-Idempotency` header, prod does. Payloads otherwise identical.
Alex R: ```json
{
  "usage": 1200,
  "customer_id": "cust_ABC123",
  "window_start": "2026-03-21T22:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2026-03-21T23:00:00Z"
}
```
Elena P: Also check timezone normalization and hour-boundary rounding — sandbox aggregator was still doing local TZ -> UTC conversion in-app until last week. That could cause some 1-hour misattributions.
Priya N: If sandbox attributes into the previous hour, reconciliation will show lower current-hour usage. We should compare window_start/window_end histograms.
Samir K: I'm going to pull the queue traces for both envs and grep for `idempotency` and `retry-count`. If v1.9 is dropping events earlier, that would explain the negative delta.
Jenkins Bot: Deploy succeeded: consumer-service v2.1 -> prod at 4311112200 by samir. CI tests passed.
Alex R: Thanks. Two parallel actions: (1) Samir to diff queue traces and forward a sample set to partners@marketplace with explanation, (2) Elena to run a 6-hr replay from prod traffic into sandbox but forcing the idempotency header absent to measure delta.
Elena P: Will do replay at 12:15 PT. I'll spin up the replay job and share job id here.
Samir K: Found a clear pattern: sandbox consumer returned 409 on duplicate writes and then didn't re-queue, whereas prod transforms 409 into a noop and ack. That resulted in ~2.9% loss when partners sent simultaneous batches.
Priya N: Nice find. Is that a simple config flip or needs code?
Samir K: Code-level. The behavior change was in the 2.0 consumer refactor (better idempotency handling). Sandbox hasn't been upgraded.
Alex R: Let's treat this as priority P1 for billing accuracy. Proposal: upgrade sandbox consumer to v2.1 and run the replay. Also create a short partner-facing note explaining the discrepancy and that invoices are unaffected for past month (we'll adjust any partner-facing numbers only after recon).
Elena P: Agree. I'll coordinate the sandbox upgrade and attach the replay results to the partners note draft.
Priya N: I'll draft the partners note and include the technical appendix (what changed, what we replayed, expected impact). Ping me when replay finished.
Samir K: Upgrade scheduled in 30m. If anyone wants to watch logs: `kubectl -n marketplace logs -f deploy/sandbox-consumer`
Alex R: Awesome — thanks team. After replay, we should run the existing reconciliation job and compare ledger differences. If delta <0.1% post-fix, we close; otherwise escalate to payments ops. :white_check_mark:
